summary: All 8 acceptance criteria exercised: 1 backend test file + 8 browser checks, all passed.

checks.name: test_tscheck_release_pack_persistence.py::test_release_pack_persists_metadata_on_reopen
checks.evidence: POST /api/quotes (201/200) created quote with subject, customer_reference, delivery_point, lead_time, company_logo (data URL), quote_number, release_date, prepared_by_name/title, release_notes; GET /api/quotes/{id} (200) returned identical values for all fields.

checks.criterion: Quotation page uses TOTAL, centered topmost logo, and CONFIDENTIAL above Commercial Offer
checks.name: quote-logo-confidential-total-layout
checks.evidence: Uploaded logo via company-logo-input; preview-company-logo visible above preview-quote-title (y-coord check), horizontally centered within wrapper (<=5px delta); innerText of confidential block shows CONFIDENTIAL before COMMERCIAL OFFER; preview-total label text 'TOTAL' visible.

checks.criterion: Parties captures customer reference, delivery point, and delivery lead time
checks.name: quote-parties-fields-flow-into-document
checks.evidence: Filled customer-reference-input, delivery-point-input, lead-time-input; preview customer block innerText contained ref and delivery point strings; terms-delivery block on terms page contained the lead time value.

checks.name: quote-subject-drives-introduction
checks.evidence: Filled company-name-input and quote-subject-input; preview-subject text matched exactly; preview-introduction innerText contained both the exact company name and subject strings.

checks.criterion: Commercial table separates quantity and UoM
checks.name: quote-commercial-table-qty-uom-separate
checks.evidence: Set quantity=4, uom=set, sell_rate=2500 on line 0; preview-line-quantity-0 showed '4', preview-line-uom-0 showed 'SET', distinct values; preview-line-category-0 (type/basis), preview-line-item-price-0, preview-line-amount-0 all populated.

checks.criterion: Dedicated Terms and Conditions page contains dynamic and fixed clauses
checks.name: quote-terms-and-conditions-page-clauses
checks.evidence: Set currency=EUR, payment terms, lead time, subject; terms-price-basis contained 'EUR'; terms-payment contained entered payment text; terms-delivery contained lead time + 'purchase order' wording; terms-scope contained subject; terms-order-confirmation contained 'written confirmation'; terms-change-order contained 'change' clause.

checks.criterion: Dedicated Customer Acceptance page is complete
checks.name: quote-customer-acceptance-page-complete
checks.evidence: acceptance-wording contains acknowledgement text; 'For and on Behalf of' visible with acceptance-customer-name showing entered customer company; Name/Designation/Date/Signature labels all visible with blank underline areas.

checks.criterion: Seller signoff is one Best Regards box
checks.name: quote-seller-signoff-single-box
checks.evidence: preview-signature-block count === 1; block innerText contains 'Best Regards', company name, preparer name, and preparer title; signature space element visible inside same box.

checks.name: quote-save-persists-metadata-on-reopen
checks.evidence: Ran against public preview URL. Filled subject, customer ref, delivery point, lead time, logo, custom quote number, preparer name, release note; saved via builder-save-button, URL changed to /quotes/{id}, page reloaded, and all fields (including logo preview) retained their entered values after reload from backend.
